implementation.settings: Added thin admin routes and a centralized settings page linking existing configuration routes. The ordinary Branding link requires oorva_brand and branding_runtime; it does not depend on oorva_admin_ops_ux or branding_editor.
implementation.historyAndRecovery: Added an always-visible admin Features-host entry to Branding history/recovery. The controller reads admin history and current generation independently of editor/runtime availability; rollback uses admin_rollback_branding with the expected generation and a required reason.
implementation.draftAndPublish: A single controller owns draft, immutable version, history, freshness, dirty-state reconciliation, save, publish, and recovery. Draft save validates the existing strict BrandingV1 schema and uses a fresh UUID; publish requires a saved clean draft, a reason, and the reviewed generation. Stale conflicts do not retry and preserve form edits.
implementation.assets: Admin uploads convert selected images to PNG and call the existing branding-assets Edge Function. Admin preview uses its authenticated short-lived signed-URL action, verifies same-project/path/expiry, avoids image cache, and drops/reissues links at expiry.
implementation.preview: Nested preview renders local draft colors and content without the global appearance provider, feature flags, theme context, cache, identity, or startup assets.
implementation.moneySafety: No payment, refund, settlement, expiry, cancellation, or other money-safety paths were edited.
